verdicts.reason: A keeps the text stack centred on the translucent band as the original does. Its flaws: the tagline sits on the busy skyline with weak contrast, the band stops partway down, and a stray band fragment is left at the bottom edge. B has the same flaws, and it also moves the headline stack off the band to the left, so 'London' and the tagline straddle the band edge. Its '<<<' chevrons are stranded at the far right, which breaks the original's centred composition and makes the layout look arbitrary.
